name: Should bathroom trim be installed before or after tile?

mainEntity.name: Should bathroom trim be installed before or after tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim installation should always take place after the bathroom tile or flooring is fully installed. Installing baseboards on top of finished tile ensures clean, tight seams and hides the expansion gap left along the perimeter of the floor. If you install baseboards before tile, the flooring cut edges remain exposed or require additional quarter-round shoe molding to conceal gaps. For homeowners remodeling in Aurora or Parker, HH Remodeling handles both tile installation and finish carpentry, coordinating the sequence so baseboards sit flush against the newly tiled surfaces before caulking and paint are applied.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim should be installed after tile is completed. This covers expansion gaps cleanly and avoids having to add extra shoe molding to hide cut edges.
